answer_en: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College was established in 1998.
answer_hi: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College ki sthapna 1998 mein hui thi.

question_variants: B.Tech M.Tech MCA available hai kya
answer_en: The college offers a four-year B.Tech in all major engineering branches, a two-year M.Tech in four branches, and a two-year MCA.
answer_hi: College mein sabhi major engineering branches mein chaar saal ka B.Tech, chaar branches mein do saal ka M.Tech, aur do saal ka MCA hota hai.

question_variants: M.Tech mein kaun si branches hain
answer_en: M.Tech is offered in electronics and communication engineering, computer science, electrical and electronics engineering, and mechanical engineering.
answer_hi: M.Tech electronics and communication engineering, computer science, electrical and electronics engineering, aur mechanical engineering mein hota hai.

question_variants: how many computers does the college have
answer_en: The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and the college has over 1400 computers networked through broadband.
answer_hi: Campus Wi-Fi se juda hai aur college mein 1400 se zyada computers broadband se networked hain.

question_variants: How many books are in the central library
answer_en: The central library is fully automated and has over 1,00,000 books, plus national and international journals, e-journals and multimedia resources.
answer_hi: Central library poori tarah automated hai aur usmein 1,00,000 se zyada books, journals, e-journals aur multimedia resources hain.

question_variants: can students use the central library
library kaun use kar sakta hai
answer_en: All students, faculty and staff of the college can use the library facilities after taking library membership.
answer_hi: College ke sabhi students, faculty aur staff library membership lekar library ki suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

question_variants: How do I enter the library
library mein entry kaise hoti hai
do I need an ID card for the library
answer_en: Entry to the central library is through the library-cum-identity card, which is scanned at the entrance.
answer_hi: Central library mein entry library-cum-identity card se hoti hai, jo entrance par scan hota hai.

answer_en: The library has membership of DELNET and the National Digital Library, and offers an e-resources database.
answer_hi: Library ke paas DELNET aur National Digital Library ki membership hai, aur e-resources database bhi hai.

question_variants: Is there a question paper bank in the library
previous year question papers library mein milte hain kya
answer_en: The central library maintains a bank of question papers and model solutions.
answer_hi: Central library mein question papers aur model solutions ka bank rakha jata hai.
source_ref: https://www.akgec.ac.in/central-library/ (dataset chunk 5; the sentence is cut off in the dataset)

question_variants: Do hostels and departments have libraries
answer_en: Departmental and hostel libraries are run by the respective departments and hostels, with resources on loan from the central library.
answer_hi: Departmental aur hostel libraries sambandhit departments aur hostels chalate hain, aur unke resources central library se loan par aate hain.

question_variants: how many students can stay in hostel
hostel mein kitne students reh sakte hain
answer_en: The college has three boys' hostels and three girls' hostels, accommodating over 1500 students.
answer_hi: College mein teen boys hostel aur teen girls hostel hain, jinmein 1500 se zyada students reh sakte hain.

question_variants: Is hot water available in the hostel
hostel mein garam pani milta hai kya
answer_en: Solar water heaters provide hot water in all 6 hostels of the college.
answer_hi: College ke sabhi 6 hostels mein garam pani ke liye solar water heaters lage hain.

question_variants: How can new students pay the fee
DD ya online transfer se fees
answer_en: New students can pay by demand draft in favour of Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College payable at Ghaziabad or Delhi, or by NEFT or RTGS online transfer.
answer_hi: Naye students demand draft se, jo Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College ke naam par Ghaziabad ya Delhi mein payable ho, ya NEFT ya RTGS online transfer se fees de sakte hain.
source_title: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question_variants: What should I write on the demand draft
DD ke peeche kya likhna hai
can I submit the DD by post
answer_en: Write your name and mobile number on the back of the draft; it can be submitted by post or in person.
answer_hi: Draft ke peeche apna naam aur mobile number likhein; use post se ya khud aakar jama kar sakte hain.
source_title: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question_variants: Is the counselling amount adjusted in the fees
counselling mein jo paisa diya wo fees mein adjust hoga kya
answer_en: The amount deposited during counselling is deducted from the total fee.
answer_hi: Counselling ke dauran jama ki gayi raashi total fees mein se ghata di jati hai.
source_title: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

answer_en: The fee structure is subject to change by the state government's fee fixation committee.
answer_hi: Fee structure rajya sarkar ki fee fixation committee dwara badla ja sakta hai.
source_title: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question_variants: What does the medical charge cover
medical charges mein kya milta hai
answer_en: Medical charges include hospitalisation insurance up to Rs 50,000, accident insurance up to Rs 1,00,000, and a free annual OPD medical checkup at Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital.
answer_hi: Medical charges mein 50,000 rupaye tak ka hospitalisation insurance, 1,00,000 rupaye tak ka accident insurance, aur Dr. R.S.G. (Indo-German) Hospital mein free annual OPD medical checkup shamil hai.
source_title: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question_variants: Do I pay the exam fee to the college
answer_en: The examination fee and the digital library fee are paid directly to the university when it asks for them, and the university may change them.
answer_hi: Examination fee aur digital library fee seedhe university ko tab dein jab woh maange; university inhe badal sakti hai.
source_title: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question_variants: caution money wapas milta hai kya
answer_en: Caution money of Rs 5000 is part of the fee and is refundable.
answer_hi: 5000 rupaye ki caution money fees ka hissa hai aur refundable hai.
source_title: AKGEC website: fee structure for new students

question_variants: UPTAC counselling se admission hota hai kya
answer_en: Admission is through UPTAC counselling, and the amount deposited during counselling is deducted from the total fee.
answer_hi: Admission UPTAC counselling ke through hota hai, aur counselling mein jama ki gayi raashi total fees mein se ghata di jati hai.
source_title: AKGEC website: admission through UPTAC counselling page

college ke director ka naam kya hai

answer_hi: Dr. Hemant Ahuja AKGEC ke Director hain, aur Dr. R.K. Agarwal Director General hain.
